scope: cpp-core/docs, excluding generated catalog files and dotfiles
classification: Multiple navigation roles inferred from names; not a pass/fail verdict
false_gate_scope: Standalone JSON only; archive members and compressed JSON are not evaluated
archive_scope: Regular files in tar.gz headers, without extraction or nested archive traversal

role_descriptions.protocol: Settings, workload definition, budgets and acceptance gates
role_descriptions.formal: Formal workers, paired measurements and formal summaries
role_descriptions.pilot: Development-only exploration; not a formal performance claim
role_descriptions.calibration: Threshold fitting using normal calibration images
role_descriptions.raw: Raw worker output, trace or process log
role_descriptions.failure_review: Named failed, clipped, interrupted or superseded attempt; inspect context
role_descriptions.false_gate: Standalone JSON contains at least one explicitly named false Boolean gate
role_descriptions.validation: Tests, sanitizer, numerical checks or archive verification
role_descriptions.source: Source code or a source snapshot/archive
role_descriptions.provenance: Hashes, manifests, environment or build provenance
role_descriptions.input: Input image, fixture or ground truth
role_descriptions.visual: Figure or image; may be either input or output
